title: AccessExplanation
description: Wire shape of `explanation` for `bregctl explain access` without `--scenario`. The evaluation-rule strings are hand-authored constants and are pinned; `routes`, `entities`, `actions`, `rowReach`, `claimContract`, and `claimContractError` are passthroughs of compiled-model values and are declared opaque, except `routes.entries[].entityId`, which is pinned because consumers read it today.

items.description: Passthrough of the compiled access-route inventory; only `entityId` is pinned. Other fields follow CompiledAccessEntry and are outside this contract version.

entities.description: Passthrough of the compiled model's per-entity access explanation; shape follows EntityAccessExplanation and is outside this contract version.

actions.description: Passthrough of the compiled action inventory; shape follows CompiledActionInventory and is outside this contract version.

rowReach.description: Passthrough of the compiled model's row-reach explanation; shape follows RowReachExplanation and is outside this contract version.

claimContract.description: Passthrough of the compiled authority inventory, or null when the registry declares no authority contract; shape follows AuthorityInventory and is outside this contract version.

claimContractError.description: The compiled authority inventory's failure, or null when the inventory was built. AuthorityInventoryError is a value-free enum serialized as one of these snake_case strings; the vocabulary is pinned and grows only with an apiVersion bump.
